rule_audit.label: Public housing termination notice and grievance prerequisite (24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57)
rule_audit.summary: A PHA termination notice must meet program-specific content and timing requirements, and when a grievance hearing is available the tenancy cannot terminate before the request period and any timely requested grievance are complete.
rule_audit.source: 24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57; Cuyahoga Metro. Hous. Auth. v. Younger, 93 Ohio App.3d 819 (8th Dist. 1994); Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § III.F

rule_audit.name: Public housing termination notice and grievance prerequisite
rule_audit.label: Public housing termination notice and grievance prerequisite (24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57)
rule_audit.summary: A PHA termination notice must meet program-specific content and timing requirements, and when a grievance hearing is available the tenancy cannot terminate before the request period and any timely requested grievance are complete.
rule_audit.source: 24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57; Cuyahoga Metro. Hous. Auth. v. Younger, 93 Ohio App.3d 819 (8th Dist. 1994); Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § III.F

Argument The termination notice's timing complied with federal regulations governing public housing. 24 C.F.R. §§ 966.4(l)(3), 966.51-.57 require a minimum 30-day notice period. The 42-day period from February 1, 2023, to March 15, 2023, satisfied the 30-day minimum. challenges.suggested_response: The record excerpt establishes that the notice advised Mr. Smith that he could request a grievance hearing by February 10, 2023. The excerpt does not establish the notice's complete contents, including any advisement concerning a right to reply, a right to examine documents, or the specific factual grounds stated for termination. CMHA therefore does not rely on the excerpt alone to establish those notice-content requirements.
